Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Airbnb's services tabs - swiping the category row switches between service categories, each landing on a springy, scaling empty-state illustration ("No matches for your dates" or "coming soon") with its own art.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
"Services in San Francisco": a search field, a horizontally scrolling category row (Photography, Chefs, Prepared meals, Massage, Training, Makeup, Nails, Hair, Spa treatments, Catering), and a content area showing either results or an empty state - a centered 3D illustration (pasta bowl, massage table, lipstick, nail polish, meal tray) with a line of copy and a "Clear dates" button where relevant.

## Motion spec
Pattern: tab crossfade with springy illustration entrance, ~450ms.
- Tab change: tapping a category (or swiping the row) recenters the row with a scroll snap (250ms, ease-out) and the active chip gets its selected treatment.
- Content: the outgoing state crossfades (200ms) as the new empty state fades in (250ms).
- Illustration: the category's artwork scales in (0.7 -> 1.04 -> 1, spring ~300/16, 450ms) with a slight rise (translateY 12px -> 0).
- Copy and button fade in under the illustration (200ms, +100ms).

## Calibration
- Each category has its own illustration - no generic placeholder.
- The scale overshoot is soft; the art should feel placed, not bounced.

## Reduced motion
Crossfade only; illustrations appear at full scale.

## Don't miss
- The category row itself scrolls to keep the active chip visible.
- "Coming soon" states have no Clear dates button - the two empty types differ.
